name: nandi-proxmox-mcp
stderr:
Usage: nandi-proxmox-mcp [options] [command]

Proxmox MCP server - open source, powered by NANDI Services

Options:
  -V, --version        output the version number
  -h, --help           display help for command

Commands:
  bootstrap [options]  Print the commands that create a Proxmox API token, ready
                       to paste into the Proxmox shell
  setup [options]      Run interactive or flag-driven setup
  doctor [options]     Run post-install checks
  harden [options]     Require human approval for every destructive tool of a
                       configured instance
  list                 List the Proxmox instances configured on this machine
  run                  Run MCP server (stdio by default, HTTP when
                       MCP_TRANSPORT=http)
  help [command]       display help for command
